title: India Tops World in IPO Count, Ranks 3rd in Funds Raised (SEBI Annual Report FY26)
summary: High domestic equity issuance volume reinforces India's position in global capital markets.

items: Public Shareholding Timeline: Largest listed companies given up to 10 years to reach mandatory 25% minimum public shareholding.
